name: genpark-personal-agent-continuous-respiratory-rate-viral-sentinel-skill
title: Continuous Nocturnal Respiratory Rate & Viral Early-Warning Sentinel Skill
description: Continuous optical nocturnal respiratory rate telemetry (brpm), tachypnea index, viral infection early-warning sentinel, and deep sleep stability index. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: detect_respiratory_rate_anomalies
tools.description: Detect statistically significant nocturnal respiratory rate spikes (> 1.5 brpm above 14-day rolling median) indicating viral onset.

tools.name: prescribe_early_immune_triage_protocol
tools.description: Synthesize rapid immune-priming and recovery protocol upon detection of prodromal respiratory elevation.
